items.question: How can ventilation work without electricity?
items.answer: The system relies on the natural difference in temperature and pressure between inside and outside, which creates a permanent natural draft.

items.question: Does it work in winter? Does the house get cold?
items.answer: Yes. The air that leaves is warm and damp while the incoming air is cool, but the constant exchange keeps the temperature comfortable.

items.question: Does it really need no maintenance?
items.answer: There are no motors, filters or electronic components. The only upkeep is occasionally cleaning the grilles.

items.question: How long does installation take?
items.answer: On average 1–2 days, depending on the size of the building.

items.question: What types of buildings is it suitable for?
items.answer: Houses, apartments, basements, attics, warehouses, shops, offices and restaurants.

t1.quote: Mold kept coming back in our bedroom no matter what we scrubbed it with. VENTPRIME treated the walls and installed passive ventilation — a year later the walls are still dry and there is no damp smell at all.

t4.quote: Fast, clean and honest work. They covered the furniture, finished in one day and took the debris with them. The attic is dry now and the musty smell disappeared completely.

t5.quote: We tried sprays and repainting twice and the black spots always came back. Their treatment plus ventilation fixed the actual cause — two seasons later the bathroom corners are still spotless.

t6.quote: One visit, one installation, no dust all over the house. The cellar stays dry ever since, even after heavy rains. Worth every leu.
